rationale: The venue is constrained by public venue-specific entrypoints; Pons curves must match the immutable factory's token/curve record. Native input is sent only to the checked venue, and native deltas are refunded to the caller. Regression tests cover arbitrary-venue rejection and Pons refunds.
The entered state is set before token, Permit2, venue, and refund interactions and reset only after settlement. Every external execution entrypoint shares this private guarded implementation.
The local is assigned on the successful factory return path; the catch branch reverts before the value is read.
